pros: One posting syndicates to 200 plus free and paid job boards
A non-recruiter can have a role live within an hour
Scorecards and mentions keep interviewer feedback on the candidate record
Monthly plans can be paused when you are not hiring
Calendar sync with Google and Microsoft removes scheduling email threads
cons: Reporting stops at pipeline velocity, source and time to fill
Permissions and process controls are coarse for multi-recruiter teams
HR modules are shallow compared with a dedicated HRIS
AI sourcing quality drops sharply for niche roles and locations
verdict_line: Pick Workable if you hire in bursts without a recruiting team and need a role posted everywhere within the hour.

pros: Interview plans assign each attribute to a named interviewer and scorecard
Roundup view surfaces evidence per attribute before a hiring decision
Report builder covers stage conversion, source and interviewer load
Several hundred marketplace integrations for assessments, checks and HRIS
Mature Harvest API supports custom internal automations
cons: Quote-based annual contracts at the high end of the market
Implementation takes weeks and needs a configuration owner
Built-in sourcing is weak, so most customers add a separate tool
Onboarding and advanced sourcing are priced as separate add-ons
verdict_line: Pick Greenhouse if you run multiple recruiters and want every hire scored the same way with defensible reporting.

pros: Review cycles combine self, manager, peer and upward input with calibration
One-on-one agendas carry over action items and pull in recent feedback
Managers act on reminders inside Slack and Microsoft Teams
Engagement results show drivers with anonymity thresholds for team dashboards
Goals feed one-on-ones, reviews and compensation cycles without re-entry
cons: Per-employee module pricing adds up quickly past a few hundred people
HRIS handles records and time off but not complex payroll or benefits
No applicant tracking, so it sits downstream of a separate ATS
Cross-module reporting often needs exports for non-standard questions
verdict_line: Pick Lattice if you want reviews, goals, one-on-ones and engagement surveys feeding each other in one system.

pros: Employer of record entities in 150 plus countries issue compliant contracts in days
Contractor invoices approved in bulk and paid in local currency
Free HRIS covers records, documents, time off and org charts
Misclassification assessment flags contractors who should be employees
Local contract templates are kept current as employment law changes
cons: Employer of record fees per head become costly past a few people per country
Standardised benefits packages cannot be tailored to local expectations
Support quality varies between established and newer country markets
No applicant tracking and only light performance management
verdict_line: Pick Deel if you pay employees or contractors in several countries and have no local entity in most of them.
